scheduledPuzzles.title: World War II Timeline
scheduledPuzzles.description: Key events from the Second World War

instructions:
This file contains example scheduled puzzles. To add new puzzles, either:
1. Use the admin interface at /admin
2. Add entries to this file and import them via the admin panel

Each puzzle requires:
- date: YYYY-MM-DD format
- eventNames: Array of exactly 6 event names that exist in the database
- title: Optional descriptive title
- description: Optional theme description
